name: David Womeldorf
title: Accounting
bio:
David’s career began in public accounting with a Big Four accounting firm. There he worked in the tax department spending much of his time on partnerships. Following public accounting, David’s accounting and tax experience has been with global and regional companies as well as small businesses. He is a licensed CPA and is a member of the AICPA and UACPA.

David earned his bachelor’s degree in History from Brigham Young University and a Master of Accounting from San Diego State University. Outside of work, David enjoys spending time with his family, long distance running, sports, and music.
